dedupe_keys.name: catalog of thermosphere ionosphere validation events for geomagnetic storms ccmc

description: This catalogue lists geomagnetic storm events used to validate thermosphere and ionosphere models within the Runs-on-Request framework of NASA's Community Coordinated Modeling Center (CCMC). Each of its 272 records is indexed by a time period identifier and gives the storm interval and phase timestamps (t0 to t4), the satellite whose accelerometer-derived neutral density is used for comparison (CHAMP, GRACE, GRACE-FO, GOCE or Swarm A), the storm type (single-peak or multiple-peak) and direct links to CCMC run outputs from models including DTM2013, DTM2020, GITM, CTIPe, JB2008, TIE-GCM, WACCM-X and WAM-IPE. It covers storms from September 2001 to December 2023. It was compiled by Jack Chieh Wang at NASA Goddard for the study Thermospheric Model Assessment During Geomagnetic Storms within the CCMC Framework, and published on Zenodo on 16 March 2026 as a single CSV file under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the file holds links, not the model outputs themselves, and those depend on the CCMC run archive staying online. It supports hazard exposure analysis of satellite drag and the validation of space weather models used in orbit prediction; a related record is the NASA CCMC platform, and another is the Starlink February 2022 storm loss case.
